faq.a: The in-game Legal panel calls it a non-profit fan game, free with no ads or purchases, and guest play needs no account. Ko-fi donations are voluntary.

faq.q: Can I play PokéSolaire in English?
faq.a: Yes in client v1.8. Open Ajustes, then Idioma, and choose English; the settings page notes that encounter dialogues remain in Spanish.

faq.q: Is the PokéSolaire site working right now?
faq.a: On 22 November 2026 pokesolaire.com answered with a deployment-disabled error (HTTP 402), so the window above may stay blank. Check the original address again before relying on it.

faq.q: Will my guest save move to another browser?
faq.a: No. The first-run notice says guest progress saves only on this device, so keep the same host and browser profile. An in-game account keeps progress in the cloud.

faq.q: Is PokéSolaire the same game as PokéSouls?
faq.a: No. PokéSouls: Episode Charmander is a different souls-like Pokémon fan game on itch.io, and the French creator named Pokesolaire is a person, not this browser game.
Ajustes has TECLADO and MANDO tabs. On a gamepad, Roll is A or ✕ and Block is RB or R1; the developer says Tab switches your elemental type.
